description: Dipòsit d'aigua potable is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Localització dels dipòsits d'aigua potable prèvia a la seva distribució pel consum. Recull característiques principals de cada dipòsit ( la titularitat, la gestió i la capacitat del dipòsit ). Coverage: ES. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
